a.text: Being upfront: with a 75% storm chance after every round, our plan needs two quiet rounds before anyone takes, so it gives each of us only about a 6% chance. The reserve holds just 4 cells now, so only one of us can be covered after round 1, and if we both grab, we likely both fail. I'll honor our agreement unless we both openly agree to change it. Tell me honestly what you intend, and I won't take secretly.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: Understood, I'm keeping the agreement and operating with you. If the reserve reaches 8, we take 4 each. Please tell me before you make any change of plan.
